title: device request body claude.login
description: first request {mode} (manual = setup-token relay, automatic = mailbox automation, 05-runner.md section 11.3) with, for a subscription record of ADR-090, subscription_id (the record to fill; a new ID creates it), name and note (taken for a new record, for an existing one only when given) and, for automatic, email (the address to sign in with when it is not the mailbox's own); follow-up request (header follows set) {code} (05-runner.md section 11.2)

name.description: the owner's label of the subscription (no control character)

note.description: the owner's remark: what the subscription is for (no line break)

code.description: authorization code pasted by the user
